First, we convert the given probability into a cumulative probability using the complement:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 4) & =1-P(X>4) \\  & =1-0.1841 \\  & =0.8159\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 4) & =0.8159 \\ P(Z\le \frac{4-\mu }{6}) & =0.8159 \\ Φ(\frac{4-\mu }{6}) & =0.8159 \\ \frac{4-\mu }{6} & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.8159)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
\Phi(0.90) = 0.8159 \quad \Rightarrow \quad \Phi^{-1}( 0.8159) = 0.90.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{4-\mu }{6} & =0.90 \\ 4-\mu  & =5.4 \\ \mu  & =-1.4.\end{aligned}
$$
